levels.description: Explicitly stated in vendor documentation or another identified primary source.
requirements: Reference a consolidated evidence document that identifies the source.
Do not treat documentation alone as runtime verification.

levels.description: Confirmed by a reproducible experiment against the target MonKey Office build.
requirements: Reference evidence derived from at least one recorded experiment.
Preserve the tested build and exact observation in research/.

levels.description: Supported by available evidence but not stated directly and not yet confirmed by a decisive experiment.
requirements: Keep the claim out of normative specification text unless clearly marked.

levels.description: A testable proposal that currently lacks sufficient supporting evidence.
requirements: Do not present the claim as language behaviour.
Prefer a minimal experiment that can confirm or reject it.
